title: Entity Terminator
text: Terminate entities, 1 input, 1 output; {Event action} sets the behavior of the entity in certain events and {Number of entities arrived, a} sets the outputs the number of entities that have arrived. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Event action
params.values: Specify the behavior of the entity in certain events Entry

params.name: Number of entities arrived, a
params.values: Outputs the number of entities that have arrived at the block off (default) | on
